chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Subbing for Baby Dodds at Kelly's Stables
summary: Zutty explains he first worked in Chicago when Baby Dodds laid off a night at Kelly's Stables, where tips were so good he took home over seventeen dollars. Dance stresses it was a high-class place.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
